channel.title: RVA Figure Drawing
channel.description: Figure drawing sessions in Richmond, VA

item.title: Sun, Nov 15 — Figure Drawing Open Session - November 15, 2026
item.description: Location: Art Works Inc, 320 Hull Street, Richmond, VA 23224 | Open Figure Drawing Session

item.title: Mon, Nov 16 · 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM — Figure Drawing Night
item.description: Location: Studio Two Three, 109 W 15th St, Richmond, VA 23224 | Cost: $20 | 3-hour figure drawing workshop with a professional nude model, with poses called by instructor Carter Helmandollar (gesture poses, short poses, then long poses). Bring your own materials; extra paper, pencils and clipboards are on hand.

item.title: Tue, Nov 17 · 10:30 AM – 12:30 PM — Figure Drawing Open Session
item.description: Location: Artspace, 2833-A Hathaway Rd., Richmond, VA 23225 | Cost: $10 donation | Open figure drawing session. All levels welcome. Chairs provided; bring your own drawing materials and arrive promptly. Minors may attend with written permission.

item.title: Wed, Nov 18 — November Queer Life Drawing
item.description: Location: Gold Lion Community Cafe, 1012 Hull Street, Richmond, VA 23224 | Chill vibe life drawing sesh celebrating queer bodies and creativity, come draw and hang out in person!
